verdict.rationale: Granola Chat documents natural-language questions about your meetings, and it can be scoped to all of your meetings from the home screen, which covers cross-history Q&A. The evidence never shows chat answers citing their source meetings or transcript passages. The magnifying-glass attribution applies only to AI-enhanced notes for a single meeting, not to chat answers. missing for 10: documented source citations or links in chat answers, independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality across a full meeting history.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can ask questions in natural language across my whole meeting history ("what did we decide about pricing?") and get answers with sources

citations.quote: Granola Chat lets you ask questions about your meetings and get instant insights from your notes or transcripts.
You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
Chat with your meeting notes to recall meeting details, spot patterns across customer calls
